items.title: Beat of Opera
items.description: Classical compositions reimagined as electronic remixes. Collaboration with the Jerusalem Symphony Orchestra conducted by Yishai Steckler. Carmen and Cherubino's Aria reworked through electronic production.

items.title: Noa Faran × DoGBeaT — Mikreh Avud EP
items.description: Joint work with Noa Faran, including a separate 2024 recording and the six-track 'מקרה אבוד' EP released March 23, 2026. Co-artist release credits are verified. Composition, production, arrangement and mixing contributions depend on the individual recording; distribution labels do not establish rights ownership.

items.title: Clone - DoGBeaT Remixes
items.description: Official remixes of selected recordings including 'I Don't Want It'. Historic views and streams are not presented as current totals. Licensing must be checked per version.

items.title: De l'esprit - DoGBeaT Remix
items.description: Sparkly disco pop remixes featuring collaborations with Yuval Maayan, Zach Sorgen, and Katrina Stone. Blending funk, rock and indie with electronic production.

items.title: Satie (Arr. for Cello) - DoGBeaT Remix
items.description: Reimagined works of Erik Satie arranged for cello with electronic production. Includes Gnossienne no. 1 & 3 and Gymnopédie no. 1. Released on Artlist Classics.

items.title: Artlist Catalog
items.description: Selected DoGBeaT recordings released via Artlist, spanning retro, electronic, funk, rock and related styles. Licenses apply to the specific recordings and versions selected on Artlist.

items.title: Theater & Television
items.description: Contributions to stage and screen music, with roles varying by work. Selected projects include work alongside Assaf Talmudi and 'Doharim' at Tmuna Theater.

items.title: Mixing & Mastering
items.description: Professional mixing and mastering services. Analog-inspired processing with digital precision. Every mix is treated as a unique sonic puzzle.
